Assistant Professor - Economics

College/School/Unit: College of Liberal Arts
Department: Department of Economics
Posted: Sep 30, 2026
Apply By: Open until filled

Description

The Department of Economics at The University of Texas at Austin
invites applications for a tenure-track Assistant Professor to
begin Fall of academic year 2027-28. We have multiple open
positions with one position designated for a macroeconomist or
international economist and one or more positions open to all
fields of economics. Duties will include undergraduate and graduate
teaching, research, and service to the department, college, and
university. We seek applicants who, through research, teaching, and
service, will contribute to the excellence of our academic
community.

Qualifications

Applicants must have completed all the requirements for the Ph.D.
by time of appointment, or they must expect to obtain the PhD
within a year of joining the faculty as Instructor. Applicants will
be evaluated based on their research record, recommendations, and
teaching ability.

Application Instructions

To apply, upload a letter of interest, CV, three letters of
recommendation, teaching portfolio, and job market paper.
Applications received by November 15, 2026, are guaranteed review.
Review of applications will continue after November 15, but the
committee may stop accepting applications at any time.

Salary is competitive and commensurate with experience and
qualifications. Position funding is subject to budget
availability.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

The University of Texas at Austin, as an equal
opportunity/affirmative action employer, complies with all
applicable federal and state laws regarding nondiscrimination and
affirmative action. The University is committed to a policy of
